signals.subject: Nico Collins

supporting_evidence: Yahoo Vaqueros roster showed Nico Collins OUT with 0.00 Week 2 projection during 2026-09-18 scout (league UI observation).

confidence.basis: Multiple outlets citing team announcement / Aaron Wilson; Yahoo UI OUT designation consistent. Grade 1 and timeline are medical reports, not independent imaging review.

potential_impact.lineup: Must not start Collins Week 2; Vaqueros moved Golden into W/T with Andrew approval.
potential_impact.waiver: Short-term WR help optional; do not drop Collins for Boutte/Downs without clear forever-bench cut.
potential_impact.trade: Temporary WR scarcity on Vaqueros; avoid selling Collins as season-ending.

signals.expiry_rationale: Week 3 practice reports will supersede Week 2 OUT status.
